design.weights: equal per item and equal per form
design.selection: Eight newly authored operational minimal pairs were frozen and content-addressed before the first tokenisation run; no item was selected or edited after seeing token counts.
design.freshness: new item set authored independently for this replication; different inputs from the referenced original

manifest.method: For each listed tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) for each frozen pair and take the arithmetic mean. The reported value is the larger (least favourable) tokenizer mean; value_lo and value_hi are the minimum and maximum pair deltas on that floor tokenizer. Both forms receive equal item weight.
manifest.analysis_plan: Report the aggregate floor and the two tokenizer means without tuning the item set to the original. Treat a value outside the original settlement tolerance as disagreement rather than editing baselines to force confirmation.
